To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a method for precise localization in dense urban environments that uses road marks as landmarks.

1) the proposed method is able to detect road marks in dense urban areas, and to reconstruct their 3D geometry, 2) the matching between the road marks and the images is robust and accurate, 3) the matching provides ground control point for LBA, which reduces the drift of the estimated trajectory.
we propose a new strategy to localize vehicles in dense urban areas using road marks and that this strategy provides a good accuracy in the estimation of the vehicle trajectory and the road marks.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: How can we detect and reconstruct road marks from a mobile mapping system? How can we use road marks as landmarks for localization? How can we integrate road marks in a localization system in order to reduce the localization errors?
